title: Key West 2 Reef Snorkel Tour & Sunset Cruise with Beer & Wine
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Please check in for the trip 30 minutes prior to departure time
Children must be accompanied by an adult
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enjoy this 3 hour sunset combo trip. We will cruise out to Key West’s best reef location, where you are welcome to jump in and enjoy an evening snorkel. If you do not feel like getting in the water, no worries, the bar is open! Grab a draft beer or glass of wine & enjoy the views. Once done snorkeling we will venture out on a one of a kind sunset cruise.
